source: Tamburini, Bommarco, Wanger, Kremen, van der Heijden, Liebman & Hallin
title: Agricultural diversification promotes multiple ecosystem services without compromising yield
topic: Second-order meta-analysis of 98 meta-analyses (5160 original studies) assessing the impact of agricultural diversification practices (e.g., intercropping, crop rotation, reduced tillage, organic amendment) on above- and belowground biodiversity, ecosystem services, and crop yield
